name: Dam Hong Duc
headline: I'm a mobile developer specialising in JavaScript and TypeScript, with a passion for building UI for web and mobile apps. I work with React Native, Flutter and Next.js, and keep learning newer tools such as SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam

about.title: Curious about me? Here you have it:
body: I studied Information Systems at the University of Science – VNUHCM, 2019 – 2023.
I have a passion for developing UI for web and mobile apps, and I started my career as a mobile developer in July 2022.
For mobile apps I have used React Native, Xamarin Forms and Flutter, and I can build native Android apps with Java and XML or with Jetpack Compose.
For the web I have used Next.js and React.

points: Front-end developer across mobile apps and the web
Tech stack: Next.js, GraphQL, React Native, Redux
Tech stack: Xamarin Forms, React Native, Redux
